"'''The Spaceport Setback / The Mission Mixup'''" is the twentieth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Two|second season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[March 19]], [[2025]].

{{Media-stub}}

==Official description==
''Kai's calm day goes awry. The Jedi have two missions.''
